title: HALL.guide
note: Stub. Correspondence nodes, not Codex's Tree gadget.

nodes.title: Mercury
nodes.body: Quicksilver. Wednesday. The lungs. Hod, the eighth sephira. Hermes the thrice-great as a job title, not a biography. Hall treats the metal, the day, the organ, and the god as one filing card.

nodes.title: Hod
nodes.body: Glory / splendour. Eighth globe on the Tree, pillar of Severity. Intellect that names. Hall's Qabbalah chapter is the claim; the Tree chapter is the furniture. This node is a door into both.

nodes.title: Hermes Trismegistus
nodes.body: Thoth, Hermes, Mercurius. Poimandres. The Book of Thoth as a lost picture-grammar later cut up as tarot. The veil is torn; the initiator points into the dark.

nodes.title: The Pyramid
nodes.body: A sermon in stone. Passages as degrees, coffer as a gate, missing capstone as a doctrine. You crawl. You wait. You stand in a room whose only furniture is a box.

nodes.title: Hiram / Chiram Abiff
nodes.body: Master craftsman of Solomon's temple, murdered at the gates for a word he would not give. Acacia on the grave. Hall reads him as a sun killed by three winter months. The lost word is a cryptogram the lodge pretends to seek.

nodes.title: The Lost Word
nodes.body: Not missing because someone forgot it. Missing because it was designed as a cryptogram. Degrees on this board are a toy version: NFO public, TXT a key, FOL the padded text.

nodes.title: The Fool
nodes.body: The unnumbered trump. The walker who can stand on any of the 22 paths. ROTA / TARO / TORA / ORAT. Hall's tarot is a shuffled Book of Thoth, not a drugstore fortune.

nodes.title: Tarot
nodes.body: 22 trumps as letters, four suits as elements and worlds. The pictures are the doctrine; the game is the cover.

nodes.title: The Tree of the Sephiroth
nodes.body: Ten globes, three pillars, twenty-two paths. 32 paths of wisdom. Daath in the abyss. Kircher's engraving is the map Western occultism never recovered from. HALL does not redraw Codex's gadget. HALL files things here.

nodes.title: Qabbalah
nodes.body: Beside the written Torah, an unwritten one: letters, numbers, and names as the same object. Sepher Yetzirah. Gematria, notarikon, temurah. Hall is a synthesist, not a rabbi.

nodes.title: Cryptogram
nodes.body: Verbose writers were not always drunk. Sometimes they were padding to conceal words. Bacon's biliteral. Acrostics. Numerical ciphers. Teletext page 033 is homework.

nodes.title: Planetary hour
nodes.body: Chaldean order: Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon. The menubar may retitle itself. It may not add a fifth Workbench color. Mercury's metal is quicksilver.
